title: ABAC governance audit
question: For every role, how many chunks of each sensitivity level did search return, and did any role receive a level above its ceiling?
sparql:
PREFIX Watson: <http://watson.local/pharma#>
PREFIX rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
SELECT ?role ?sensitivity (COUNT(?event) AS ?retrievals)
       (IF(?role = "VIEWER" && ?sensitivity IN ("RESTRICTED", "CONFIDENTIAL"), "VIOLATION",
        IF(?role = "ANALYST" && ?sensitivity = "CONFIDENTIAL", "VIOLATION", "ok")) AS ?verdict)
WHERE {
  ?event a Watson:RetrievalEvent ;
         Watson:userRole ?role ;
         Watson:retrievedChunk ?chunk .
  ?chunk Watson:sensitivityLevel ?sensitivity .
}
GROUP BY ?role ?sensitivity
ORDER BY ?role ?sensitivity
